tables.title: Moves
rows: She lobs three poison bottles 0.6 秒onds apart across a 90-degree fan、and each one leaves a cloud that lasts 8 秒onds、Poisons anyone inside. Keep moving through the volley、don't fight inside the clouds.

She winds up for about a 秒ond、then throws a single flask that bursts where it lands、dealing 爆炸 damage around the impact、knocking you back hard. It's the throw she uses from farthest away、so sidestep when she winds up rather than backing off.

A long bucket swing splashes four or five slimes out in a line in front of her、with up to eight alive at once、no more than one swing every 30 秒onds. 近战 hits these slimes 25% harder、so cut through them before they surround you.
When the slime bucket finishes、two or three Cave Spiders appear around her、with no more than five at a time. They're faster than she is、take double 闪电 damage、so a 闪电 hit clears them quickly.
Once she drops below 60% health she stops to drink a potion that heals her over 10 秒onds、and she can only do it once every two minutes. The drink takes 2.6 秒onds、a clean window to hit her.

If you get close while her flee is ready、she throws down an invisibility potion、becomes untargetable until she finishes fleeing or 10 秒onds pass. She can't throw potions or use the slime bucket while invisible.

Straight after turning invisible she runs for a flee point in the arena at double speed、can't be knocked back until she gets there、at most once every 10 秒onds. Chasing her rarely pays、so spend that time on the slimes、spiders.
